reason: A persistent-memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that stores project-scoped Markdown memories, recalls relevant context across sessions, exposes memory management tools, and provides a web interface.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目隔离的持久记忆，将记忆保存为 Markdown 文件并支持跨会话召回、搜索、编辑、删除和网页管理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for project-scoped persistent memory with Markdown storage, cross-session recall, search, editing, deletion, and web-based management.

capabilities: Stores and updates project-scoped Markdown memory files
Reads and recalls relevant memory into new sessions
Provides memory search, listing, editing, deletion, and tag suggestion tools
Provides a web UI for managing memories
Imports existing Claude Code memories non-destructively
